lines.japanese: 「るァァ──っ！」
lines.english: “Rrraaagh!”

lines.japanese: 俺は駆けよりざま、生まれたての光沢を残す真っ赤な自転車を蹴倒した。
lines.english: I charged in and kicked over a red bicycle still gleaming factory-new.

lines.japanese: スペイン料理屋の前、呑気な通行人たちが、山から下りてきた獣でも見るような目で俺を見ていた。
lines.english: Outside the Spanish restaurant, carefree passersby stared as though a wild beast had wandered down from the mountains.

lines.japanese: 「おいコルァァ！　隠れてンだらァ！　聞きてえことあッから、とっとと出てこいやゴキブリ共ォ！」
lines.english: “Hey, assholes! I know you’re hiding! I’ve got questions, so crawl the fuck out here, you roaches!”

lines.japanese: 俺は横たわった自転車を音高く踏みつけて叫んだ。
lines.english: I screamed as I stamped on the fallen bicycle with a crash.

lines.japanese: 醜い激情の発露は一瞬ばかり群衆を竦ませたが、その怯えもすぐに嘲りに変わった。この街じゃ怒りに咆哮する酔っぱらいなど珍しくもない。ぬるめの白い視線が、肩を揺らす俺の体にいくつも集まってきた。
lines.english: The ugly eruption cowed the crowd for barely an instant before fear turned to scorn. A drunk roaring in fury was nothing rare in this town. Mildly contemptuous stares settled on my heaving body from every side.

lines.japanese: その嘲笑の合間合間から染みでてくるように、いくつかの黒い人影がにじりよってきた。やつらは笑っていなかった。それぞれの手にある凶器と同じように、冷ややかな表情をしていた。
lines.english: As though seeping from the cracks between their jeers, several silhouettes in black began to close in. They weren't laughing. Their faces were as cold as the weapons in their hands.

lines.japanese: 「よく来たな、八木ィ」
lines.english: “Nice of you to come, Yagi.”

lines.japanese: 佐久間がいつになく押しつぶした声で言った。
lines.english: Sakuma spoke in a low, suppressed voice unlike any I had heard from him before.

lines.japanese: 「じゃねえや、成田ッつうんだってなあ？」
lines.english: “No, wait. It's Narita, isn't it?”

lines.japanese: 「あァっ！？」
lines.english: “The hell?”

lines.japanese: ゆうべ遭遇したときとは何故か一転している居丈高な物腰に、俺は疑問と苛立ちを覚えた。しかし、そんなことはいまの俺にとってどうでもいいことだった。
lines.english: For some reason, his overbearing swagger was a complete reversal from the night before, and I felt both puzzled and irritated. Right then, however, I couldn't have cared less.

lines.japanese: 「おう、言え佐久間。糞オウムはどこだコラ」
lines.english: “Spit it out, Sakuma. Where's that fucking parrot?”

lines.japanese: 一歩ずつ詰めよってくるパンク小僧に、俺はみずからも大股で近付いていった。
lines.english: The little punk advanced one step at a time. I strode straight toward him in return.

lines.japanese: 「知らねえよ。知ってても言わねえよコラ」
lines.english: “Don't know. Wouldn't tell you if I did.”

lines.japanese: 「言わねえよコラじゃねえよ。言うんだよコラ」
lines.english: “Don’t give me ‘wouldn’t tell you.’ You’re telling me.”

lines.japanese: 「言うんだよコラじゃねえよ。言わねンだよコラ」
lines.english: “Don’t give me ‘you’re telling me.’ I’m not telling you shit.”

lines.japanese: 視線を射合いながら歩きつづける俺たちは、どちらも退かなかった。
lines.english: We kept walking, eyes locked. Neither gave an inch.

lines.japanese: 互いの体が互いの行く手を阻む距離になった。俺は目を逸らさぬまま、短く頭を振りおろした。やつが取った行動も同じだった。
lines.english: We came close enough for our bodies to bar each other’s path. Without breaking eye contact, I snapped my head down. He did the same.

lines.japanese: 叩きあわさった額からこもった音と衝撃が走り、視界が弾けて揺れた。
lines.english: Our foreheads cracked together with a muffled thud. My vision flashed and reeled from the impact.

lines.japanese: 俺たちは額をがりがり擦りつけあったまま、互いのくさい息がかかる距離で相手の殺気立った瞳を睨んだ。
lines.english: Foreheads grinding together, close enough to share foul breath, we glared into each other's murderous eyes.

lines.japanese: 「なんで言えねンだコラ。てめ、なに今更あのカマかばってんだこの野郎」
lines.english: “Why won’t you tell me? Why the fuck are you protecting that fag now, asshole?”

lines.japanese: 「今更じゃねンだよ。てめ、よくもフカシこいてくれたなこの野郎」
lines.english: “Now, my ass. You fed us a load of shit, bastard.”

lines.japanese: 「アァっ？　てめ、俺が何月何日、何時何分何秒にフカシこいたっつんだこの野郎」
lines.english: “Oh yeah? Tell me exactly when—month, day, hour, minute, second—I ever lied to you, asshole!”

lines.japanese: 「何時何分もクソもねえだろ、ああッ！　てめえは名前も何も、最初から全部フカシこきまくりだったじゃねえかこの野郎」
lines.english: “Who gives a fuck about the hour and minute? Your name, your story—everything out of your mouth was bullshit from the very start!”

lines.japanese: 「だから！　俺が何のフカシこいたかッつってんだ、言ってみろこの野郎」
lines.english: “Then tell me! Tell me what I lied about, asshole!”

lines.japanese: 「ファック！　バックレてんじゃねえぞこの野郎、ネタァ割れてんだ──」
lines.english: “Fuck! Quit playing dumb, you bastard. We know the truth—”

lines.japanese: 「──ハリューやったの、てめえだってな！」
lines.english: “—you're the one who took down Haryu!”

lines.japanese: 「ハアアッ！？」
lines.english: “Whaaat!?”

lines.japanese: 一瞬、やつが何を言ってるのか理解できなかった。ハリューだと？　こいつらの偉大な神さまがいまさら何だってんだ。
lines.english: For a moment, I couldn't understand him. Haryu? What did their great and mighty god have to do with anything now?

lines.japanese: 「制裁」
lines.english: “Retribution.”

lines.japanese: その刹那、わずかな面積の感触が背中に押しあてられた。振りむく間もなかった。
lines.english: In that instant, a tiny point pressed into my back. There was no time to turn.

lines.japanese: ばちり！　その「点」を中心とした単発の痺れが、俺の全身を撃った。
lines.english: Crack! A single electric jolt burst outward from that point and shot through my entire body.

lines.japanese: 「かっ！」
lines.english: “Gah!”

lines.japanese: 筋肉が強張って四肢が硬直した。そのせいで体が揺らぎ、俺は前のめりにつんのめる──
lines.english: My muscles clenched and my arms and legs locked rigid. My balance went with them, pitching me forward—

lines.japanese: ──正面の佐久間が、ポケットから自慢のナイフを抜きだしたのが見えた。俺は倒れかけながらも、咄嗟にやつの手の甲を殴りつけた。刃物が音を立てて歓楽街の底に転がった。
lines.english: —and straight ahead, I saw Sakuma draw his precious knife from his pocket. Even as I fell, I struck the back of his hand on reflex. The blade clattered onto the pavement.

lines.japanese: 俺は前に引っぱられてゆく体に自ら加速を付け、とんとんとんとそのまま数歩進んだ。進みながら体をひるがえした。
lines.english: I threw my own momentum into the fall and staggered several quick steps, turning as I went.

lines.japanese: 「だ、誰だァ！？」
lines.english: “W-who the hell are you!?”

lines.japanese: 青い目をしたやさ男が、電気シェーバーに似た黒い塊を手にして笑っていた。
lines.english: A slender blue-eyed man stood smiling, a black object like an electric razor in his hand.

lines.japanese: 「参ったなあ、今ので気絶してくれないワケ？」
lines.english: “Well, this is awkward... You’re telling me that didn’t knock you out?”

lines.japanese: 「満夜！　だから２０ボルトじゃ足りねえっつったろ！」
lines.english: “Mitsuya! I told you twenty volts wouldn't be enough!”

lines.japanese: 「いやいや、違うって。彼が頑丈すぎるんだよ」
lines.english: “No, no, that’s not it. He’s just way too tough.”

lines.japanese: 「んなこたあハナから分かってたじゃねえか！」
lines.english: “We knew that from the goddamn start!”

lines.japanese: 仲間をなじりながら、佐久間は落としたナイフを拾った。その背後から、さらなる別部隊が歩みでてきた。
lines.english: Berating his companion, Sakuma stooped to recover the knife. Behind him, still more of their crew stepped forward.

lines.japanese: 「どいて咲夜。まかせて満夜」
lines.english: “Move, Sakuya. Leave this to me, Mitsuya.”

lines.japanese: 腰まで届く長い髪の女が、夜のネオン街につややかな銀の線を走らせた。特殊警棒。その隣りのピンク頭の女は、ベルトからしゅるりと細いワイヤー線を引きぬいた。まるで護身グッズの展覧会だ。
lines.english: A woman with hair to her waist drew a lustrous silver line through the neon night: a telescoping baton. Beside her, a pink-haired woman slipped a fine length of wire from her belt. It was a whole exhibition of self-defense gear.

lines.japanese: 「欺かれた教徒の嘆き。卑屈な耳に届かざるや」
lines.english: “Hear the lament of the faithful deceived. Does it not reach your craven ears?”

lines.japanese: 雑踏のあいだに低いどよめきが広がる。男は好奇心に足を止め、女は身を縮ませて逃げだした。通報されるのも時間の問題──いや、もうされてるのかもしれない。
lines.english: A low murmur spread through the crowd. Men stopped in curiosity; women shrank away and fled. It was only a matter of time before someone called the police—if they hadn't already.

lines.japanese: 「くっそ！」
lines.english: “Shit!”

lines.japanese: なんでこうなる。俺はただ、あの糞オウムの居所を突きとめたいだけだってのに！
lines.english: Why was this happening? All I wanted was to find out where that fucking parrot was!

lines.japanese: ハリュー・クロードがどこかの暴漢に襲われた件なんて、すでに過去の話だったはずだ。それが何故いまさら蒸しかえされてる？　しかも、なぜ俺がやったことになってる……！
lines.english: Haryu Claude's assault by some thug should have been old news. Why resurrect it now? And why the hell had they decided I did it...?

lines.japanese: 「成田ァ、もう弁解は聞かねえぞォ！　いままでさんざん耳貸してやったのによォ、よくも騙してくれたよなァ、地獄でクソ喰らえやこのペテン野郎！」
lines.english: “Narita, we're done listening to excuses! We gave you chance after chance, and you still played us for fools! Eat shit in hell, you lying bastard!”

lines.japanese: 「ふざけんな。おまえらは俺に騙されたんじゃねえ、いま俺じゃねえ誰かに騙されてんだ！」
lines.english: “Fuck off. I didn't fool you. Somebody else is fooling you right now!”

lines.japanese: 「すでに言葉はいらないの。天に唾した愚行の酬い、定めの夜に判決は下った」
lines.english: “Words are no longer needed. For the folly of spitting at Heaven, sentence was passed on the appointed night.”

lines.japanese: 「我らが主の聖痕にかけて、赦されざる咎に裁きを！　紅き涙をもって朱き血を漱がん！　キエエエエ！」
lines.english: “By the stigmata of our Lord, judgment upon the unforgivable transgression! With crimson tears shall scarlet blood be cleansed! Aaaaiiiieee!”

lines.japanese: 幽霊女が泣きさけぶような顔で警棒を振りあげた。ざわめく群衆。俺は慎重な速度でじりじり後退する。
lines.english: The ghostly woman raised her baton, face twisted as though wailing in grief. The crowd stirred. I edged backward at a measured pace.

lines.japanese: 「大司教だな！　あの糞オウム、あいつがなんか言ったんだな！」
lines.english: “The Archbishop, right? That fucking parrot told you something!”

lines.japanese: あいつがこの連中を煽ってるんだな！
lines.english: He was the one who had set these people on me!

lines.japanese: くそ……くそ、くそ、くそ、くそっ！
lines.english: Shit... Shit, shit, shit, shit!

lines.japanese: 「世界が平和でありますようにだコノヤロウ！」
lines.english: “*May peace prevail on Earth*, assholes!”

lines.japanese: 激情を抑えるためのまじないを叫び──隙が見えた──俺はきびすを返して逃げだした。
lines.english: I shouted the charm meant to contain my fury—saw an opening—and turned on my heel and ran.

lines.japanese: 力ずくでもオウムの居所を吐かせたかったが、多勢に無勢だ。なにより、ひとの目が有りすぎる。
lines.english: I wanted to beat the parrot's location out of them, but I was one against many. More than anything, there were too many witnesses.

lines.japanese: 俺は苛立ち──いや、これは紛れもなく忘れていた感情、怒りと憎しみだ──を抱えながら、人ごみの中を走りぬけた。誰に肩が当たろうと知ったことではなかった。
lines.english: Frustration drove me through the crowd—no, there was no mistaking it. This was the anger and hatred I had forgotten. I did not care whose shoulder I hit.

lines.japanese: 「邪魔だクソ、どけ！」
lines.english: “Out of my way, damn it!”

lines.japanese: 血が騒ぐ。血が滾る。血が沸きたつ。
lines.english: My blood stirred. My blood seethed. My blood boiled.

lines.japanese: 憎悪と怨嗟。誰かをやっつけてやりたいと思う気持ち。
lines.english: Hatred and resentment. The urge to beat somebody down.

lines.japanese: 関係ねえやと思った。
lines.english: Screw it, I thought.

lines.japanese: 世界に平和なんてあるものかよ。
lines.english: Peace on Earth, my ass.

lines.japanese: 他にあてもなく、ただじっとしていられないという焦燥に駆られてここへ来た。
lines.english: I'd come here with no other lead, driven by the restless need to do something—anything.

lines.japanese: オウム頭といえばここしか思いつかなかった。
lines.english: When I thought of the parrot-head, this was the only place that came to mind.

lines.japanese: やつらの崇める浅黒い肌の神さまが降臨した、陰気なライブハウス。
lines.english: The gloomy live-music club where the dark-skinned god they worshiped had descended among them.

lines.japanese: しかしいま、この輝ききれない薄明かりに照らされた通廊は、夢や家庭や約束を持つ有象無象がせわしく行きかい、その頭上をときおり鈍重な轟音がよぎってゆくばかりだった。
lines.english: Now, though, the covered passage lay under weak lights that never quite shone. Anonymous people with dreams, families, and promises hurried in both directions while a heavy roar passed overhead every so often.

lines.japanese: 「どこに……」
lines.english: “Where...”

lines.japanese: 「どこに隠れてんだ糞野郎……！」
lines.english: “Where are you hiding, bastard...?”

lines.japanese: 俺は硬い安全靴の先端で、落書きと剥げたチラシだらけの壁を力任せに蹴った。
lines.english: I drove the hard toe of my safety shoe into a wall plastered with graffiti and peeling flyers.

lines.japanese: 「はあ……はあ……はあ……」
lines.english: “Hah... hah... hah...”

lines.japanese: 反響した自分の怒声が、感情の昂ぶりに制止をかけた。
lines.english: The echo of my own furious cry arrested the surge inside me.

lines.japanese: 俺は髪に手櫛を通して、車道沿いの排気くさい風を吸いこんだ。
lines.english: I raked a hand through my hair and drew in the exhaust-tainted wind off the road.

lines.japanese: 冬の夜がひどく冷たいことを思いだした。この汚れた壁に叩きつけられた極彩色の頭を思いだした。そして、処刑執行人であるイカれた瞳のニワトリを思いだした。
lines.english: I remembered how brutally cold a winter night could be. I remembered the garishly colored head smashed against this filthy wall. And I remembered the mad-eyed chicken who had carried out the execution.

lines.japanese: 鳳翔。俺はゆうべ、やつと約束を交わしていた。妹の情報と引きかえに、俺は今夜、やつの（何故だか気を重くさせる）話を聞いてやらなければならない。
lines.english: Kakeru Otori. The night before, I had struck a bargain with him. In exchange for information about his sister, tonight I had to listen to whatever he meant to tell me—something that weighed on me for reasons I couldn't name.

lines.japanese: 一瞬、俺は約束を反故にすることを考えた。事実、そんな暇や余裕はないように思える。
lines.english: For one moment, I considered breaking the promise. Truthfully, I did not have the time or presence of mind to keep it.

lines.japanese: しかし、と俺は考えなおす。
lines.english: But then I reconsidered.

lines.japanese: あるいは、あのニワトリなら何か──敵であるあの大司教に関する何かを握っているかもしれない。
lines.english: That chicken might know something—something about his enemy, the Archbishop.

lines.japanese: 俺は乾いたコンクリートタイルを蹴って、ヘテロクロミアへ走りだした。
lines.english: I kicked off from the dry concrete tiles and ran toward Heterochromia.

lines.japanese: 急ぐ必要があるのかは自分でも分からなかったけれど、とにかく俺は走った。
lines.english: I didn't know whether there was any need to hurry. I ran anyway.

lines.japanese: 「平和だコノヤロウ！」
lines.english: “Peace, goddamn it!”

lines.japanese: 迫りあがってくる何かを抑えつけながら。
lines.english: All the while, I forced down something that threatened to surge up inside me.
